Saucon identified a critical need for real-time ferry tracking to streamline bus operations and improve passenger transportation. In response, we deployed the Saucon Telemetry Delivery System (TDS), optimizing scheduling and significantly enhancing service efficiency. This success not only alleviated congestion but also led to the installation of Saucon TDS across the entire NY Waterway fleet. Today, Saucon is a leading provider of innovative solutions for the transportation industry across North America. Our integrated suite of technologies supports businesses in reaching their full potential through over-the-air data capture, intelligent data collection, systems integration, and electrification initiatives. Say goodbye to costly delays and unnecessary tows! Saucon’s Remote Service Tool (RST) is the smarter, more cost-effective way for bus operators to maintain and optimize their fleet. With secure RP1210c connectivity, the Saucon RST datalink enables technicians the power to diagnose, clear fault codes, adjust parameters, and optimize vehicle performance—all remotely! Even diesel engine regenerations can be initiated without an on-site visit. Built with advanced encryption and security, RST ensures safe, seamless communication between your fleet and your technicians. Currently supporting Cummins Insite®, Saucon’s RST will soon expand to additional diagnostic management tools—bringing even more power to your fleet operations. This game-changing technology is redefining vehicle servicing. Less downtime. More efficiency. Smarter fleet management. Get ahead with Saucon’s Remote Service Tool today! subpages.title: TPMS - Saucon
subpages.desc: Saucon's Tire Pressure monitoring can provide notifications to potentially stop a thermal event saving your company a time and money.
subpages.text: TECHNOLOGIES Technologies IoT Telematics Electric Revolution Smart Data Delivery Seamless Integration SOLUTIONS Bus and Motorcoach Real-Time Monitoring Safe Driver Electronic Driver Logs Mobile Apps and Data Integration Fleet Maintenance and DVIR Compliance Passenger Wi-Fi Onboard Video and Security Scheduling, Dispatch and Forecasting Saucon Vision AI Touch to Talk Remote Service Tool Tire Pressure Monitoring Remote Regeneration Data Systems Integration Tire Pressure Monitoring Fueling Automation Smart Filtering Modbus Gateway Remote Generator Monitoring Data Integration Electrification Battery Electric Hybrid Electric Hydrogen Electric ABOUT US GET IN TOUCH Home 5 Solutions 5 Bus & Motorcoach 5 TPMS Tire Pressure Monitoring System Monitoring for a safe driving environment The system focuses on preventing potential tire-related issues including thermal events by providing real-time feedback and alerts to drivers. Saucon works with third-party TPMS partners by monitoring tire conditions in real-time to enhance vehicle safety. Saucon uses sensors to monitor tire pressure and tire speed of rotation. This data is gathered from sensors installed on each tire, which is then transmitted to the Saucon onboard computer device (Prox). Once on the Prox device, the data is monitored and consumed so that Drivers can be alerted of a potential issue and lessen the chances of a thermal event. This helps prevent accidents and extends tire life by addressing problems before they become severe. Features and Benefits Saucon integrates with various TPMS systems that provide continual tire pressure monitoring The system generates alerts and notifications for drivers Historical reporting of collected tire monitoring data Asset configurations for tire pressure and temperature threshold levels
